## 7. Refactoring and evidence

These working blocks establish the reference behavior before refactoring.

```{r}
change_a <- followup - baseline
category_a <- ifelse(is.na(change_a), "missing",
                     ifelse(change_a < 0, "decrease", "no decrease"))
original_a <- data.frame(change = change_a, category = category_a)

change_b <- followup_b - baseline_b
category_b <- ifelse(is.na(change_b), "missing",
                     ifelse(change_b < 0, "decrease", "no decrease"))
original_b <- data.frame(change = change_b, category = category_b)
original_a
original_b
```
